en: I see.
Good day to you, then, Mr. Scott.
How'd that fella know my name
Can't pour the shop's liquor when I'm closed.
Half of life's pleasure is drinkin'.
The other half's bein' with the woman you love.
So women, right from the start,
are missin' out on half of life, I reckon.
Your order... I mean,
note: Servant msg: next line is 'Your orders......' (pun on order/orders).

en: Welcome to our refined restaurant,
"Thompson's".
Our specialty is tender, juicy
roast beef.
By the way, sir, might you have
a reservation?
I have made no such thing.
My apologies.
We are fully booked for today.
I can book you for tomorrow or later,
so may I have your name?
Your reservation is confirmed.
We look forward to your visit.
I have none.
Ah, you have a reservation, sir.
Allow me to show you to your table.
How would you like your meat cooked?
Make it rare.
Certainly.
Thank you for waiting. Our specialty,
No heavy sauce, just salt, pepper
and herbs to bring out the meat's flavor.
And here is some Yorkshire pudding.
Enjoy.
note: Shared: after Yorkshire pudding (#3551) and after the dessert line (#3560).

en: Hmm...
This is rather good.
We will prepare the special dinner
right away.
Today's menu is
roast lamb with mint sauce
and quail casserole.
For dessert, apple and blackberry pie.
Hmm. That was rather good.
Was everything to your liking?
I'll book another reservation for you.
Might I suggest fish today?
We can prepare the finest Dover sole
for you.
I leave it to you.
Please wait a moment.
Thank you for waiting.
Besides the sole, we have prepared trout
baked in foil with plenty of herbs, and
Scottish salmon.
Well, fish is not bad either.
Bringing out the flavor with salt, pepper
and herbs is this country's traditional
way of cooking.
This is "Thompson's" restaurant.
We are in the middle of preparing
for dinner.
We open after noon, so please wait a little.
The restaurant is not open yet.
It's still a bit early
for dinner.
Could you wait a little longer?
Christmas is coming soon, after all.
We must prepare a superb menu
Should it be goose with apple sauce,
or turkey with cranberry sauce?
I just can't decide.
For Christmas dessert, of course, we'll
serve pudding.
Did you know?
Whoever finds a silver coin in the pudding
is promised a year of good luck...
(Hmph. Christmas, is it? What drivel.
Let them carry on like fools, then.)
Can't I come in without a reservation?
I can book you for tomorrow or later,
, is it, sir?
